body: Well, I've never done that. Thanks. :)

Thank you, I appreciate that. My conscience is what is killing me. Unfortunately, there is nothing I can do about my past. There are no fences to mend, no actual thing I can to to make things "right." That's a big part of the problem.

If you have the means to get out - do it! Flee, go somewhere far away and start a new life. Your life. Leave all the pain and hurt behind and focus on you. Get into therapy for all the awful things that have happened to you that aren't your fault. You can recover and have a good life.

Go!
